{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVAV-ec8AAAABWO72OA", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BmJKvzg_yI70", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BmJKv", "number": 20, "title": "Remove MPFB integration and obsolete compatibility/state for a clean-slate gen3d", "body": "## Problem

The optional MPFB-assisted mode has not produced the intended results for stylized/anime characters: a recent actual trial yielded an undesirably realistic, ape-like face. It also adds a second modeling path and related settings, tools, project state, validation code, and documentation that no longer align with the desired design.

gen3d is early-stage. **Backward compatibility is not required at all. Old local projects, generated artifacts, and legacy state may be discarded.** We want the simplest clean implementation, not a disabled feature or compatibility shim.

## Expected outcome

Completely remove the gen3d-specific MPFB integration and obsolete modeling-mode/legacy state without disrupting the **remaining** text-or-image → image reference(s) → Codex + Blender MCP → model → optional visual refinement → review/export workflow.

- Remove MPFB selectors and special-case UI/MCP/HTTP fields, commands, service calls and guards, generated metadata, adapter/runtime and MPFB-specific tests/scripts.
- Remove the scratch-vs-MPFB mode switch where it exists solely for MPFB; a single ordinary Blender modeling path remains (no redundant `scratch` configuration).
- Remove stale compatibility fallbacks, migrations, defaults and unused state branches whose only purpose is old project formats. Prune obsolete documentation, examples, links, UI comparisons and dependencies/validation scripts tied to MPFB.
- Design around a **fresh local project data store**. Do not implement migration, backfill, historical replay, import/export compatibility or dual-schema support for pre-change projects. Do not retain unnecessary branches solely to read prior generated MPFB results.
- Explicitly document how to start fresh by clearing **only gen3d-managed application data** (default `~/.gen3d`, or configured `GEN3D_DATA_DIR`) and any applicable app-local browser selection. Do not automatically delete unrelated files, external Blender add-ons, third-party assets or arbitrary user folders. No invisible destructive wipe on server startup.
- Keep the relevant existing features (Web UI stage navigation, multi-view references, configurable consistency check, optional visual refinement, human review, shared gen3d MCP/HTTP state, normal Codex/Blender workflow, GLB/.blend exports).

This is an intentional breaking change. Do not add compatibility behavior in order to preserve old data; Git history provides provenance if needed.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] No active MPFB choice, tool, adapter, configuration, modeling prompt, model-state field, special renderer path or MPFB-specific requirements remain in normal source/UI/API/MCP.
- [ ] Remove unneeded MPFB scripts, dedicated tests, documentation/setup instructions and obsolete dual-method comparison UI; clean up `package.json` scripts and any now-unused references.
- [ ] Persist only the current supported project schema; obsolete legacy migration/compatibility branches are removed rather than carried forward. Fresh project creation/restart is verified.
- [ ] An explicit, scoped clean-start procedure is documented. A reset affects only the configured gen3d-managed data store; it does not delete unrelated files or user-installed Blender add-ons.
- [ ] Text and uploaded-image projects still generate through the ordinary local Codex/Blender path; multi-view checks, review checkpoints, bounded visual refinement and exports remain functional.
- [ ] Web UI and gen3d MCP/HTTP present one coherent model-generation flow, without stale labels, schemas or removed state.
- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run check` pass; update applicable browser tests, record actual validation performed and do not claim live Blender/Codex results unless run.
- [ ] No unnecessary migration layer, old-format support, legacy-only tests or speculative replacements are introduced.

## Post-merge verification

None.

## Optional validation

- Fresh local end-to-end authenticated Codex + Blender run after clearing only gen3d's own data, if prerequisites are available. Clearly distinguish live checks from injected tests.

## Context

- #3 — Project vision and goals
- #16 — Introduced optional MPFB mode (now intentionally superseded)
- #18 — Visual refinement, which must continue working without MPFB
- Planned companion Issue: persistent local 3D reference model library.
- Relevant code: `src/runner.js`, `src/store.js`, `src/mcp.js`, `src/server.js`, `src/modeling-mode.js`, `src/mpfb.js`, `blender/mpfb_runtime.py`, `web/`, `tests/`, `scripts/`, `docs/`.

The external user's standalone MPFB installation is **not** part of gen3d-managed data and must never be uninstalled as a side effect.
